title: OSS-IQ Export Schema v1.5
description: Schema for OSS-IQ project metrics export data (v1.5 adds epss to PackageMetrics, TransitivePackageMetrics and CVEInfo, runs_code_at_install/install_execution_reason to PackageMetrics and TransitivePackageMetrics, fix_age_days to CVEInfo, project_epss/packages_with_epss/packages_with_unscored_cves to summary, declares update_transitive_impacts, and replaces the phi_i/phi_p/phi_a CSI channels with the maintenance-state model: maintenance_state, maintenance_risk, maintenance_coverage, flow_trend, engagement_buckets, deprecation_signals and deprecation_successor on PackageMetrics and TransitivePackageMetrics, and packages_unmaintained/packages_deprecated on summary; and adds latest_compatible_major, module_system, recommended_module_system to PackageMetrics and TransitivePackageMetrics, and breaking_change to PackageMetrics; and adds engine_requirement, engine_compatible, engine_context_source to PackageMetrics and TransitivePackageMetrics; and adds metadata.warnings and a scan-level runtime_context block, moving engine_context_source off the per-package models; and adds next_action to PackageMetrics and TransitivePackageMetrics and requires_constraint_widening to PackageMetrics, so every surface reads one next-action label instead of re-deriving it)

schema_version.description: Version of the export schema format

export_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the export was generated

update_strategy.description: The update-strategy tier this run targeted: security, deprecation, standard, latest, or cutting-edge.

data_completeness.description: B4: per-source data-source status for this scan

overall.description: Worst status across every tracked source

sources.description: Per-source status, one entry per scan step that reports completeness

failures.description: Causes behind a degraded status, counted by cause; empty when the step was ok

api_budgets.description: Quota observed or forecast for each metered API this scan touched

resource.description: The metered resource, as the API names it, e.g. 'core', 'graphql'

remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

reset_at.description: Epoch seconds at which the window rolls over

needed.description: Requests this scan was forecast to need against this resource

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems found while assembling the project's sources, e.g. a tree containing more than one package registry

runtime_context.description: The runtime this scan checked engine requirements against, stated once for the whole scan

engine_versions.description: Runtime versions every record's engine_compatible was checked against, e.g. {'node': '20.11.0'}

engine_context_source.description: Which source populated engine_versions: 'detected' (actually-installed runtime), 'declared' (manifest floor), or 'none'

npm_cli_version.description: Detected npm CLI version; display-only, null on PyPI or when not probed

project_declares_esm.description: Whether the project's own manifest declares `"type": "module"` (npm only)

summary.description: Summary statistics for the scanned project

packages_with_cves.description: Number of packages with known CVEs

total_cves.description: Total number of CVEs across all packages

packages_outdated.description: Number of packages behind the latest version

project_epss.description: EPSSg over every distinct scored package in the project, direct and transitive

packages_with_epss.description: Number of distinct packages contributing to project_epss

packages_with_unscored_cves.description: Number of packages with a CVE where no CVE carries an EPSS score

packages_with_stability.description: Distinct packages whose upstream repository was measured

packages_unmaintained.description: Assessed packages whose most probable state is abandoned or deprecated

packages_deprecated.description: Assessed packages whose most probable state is deprecated

packages_stability_unknown.description: Packages with no measurement: no repository URL, a non-GitHub host, or statistics unavailable

transitive_packages.description: Transitive dependency metrics, one entry per unique (package_name, installed_version); path and constraint data lives in dependency_tree

dependency_tree.description: Dependency tree rooted at each direct production dependency; nodes carry edge-specific constraint data and reference transitive_packages by id

constraint_type_map.description: Lookup table for ct integer field in DependencyTreeNode; index 0=DECLARED, 1=NARROWED, 2=PINNED, 3=ADDITIVE, 4=OVERRIDE

DependencyTreeRoot.description: Root entry in the dependency tree, anchored at a direct production dependency

package_name.description: Name of the direct production dependency

children.description: Transitive packages directly required by this production dependency

DependencyTreeNode.description: One node in the dependency tree; ref matches id in transitive_packages, ct indexes into constraint_type_map

ref.description: Matches the id field of a TransitivePackageMetrics entry

ct.description: Index into the top-level constraint_type_map array

version_constraint.description: Version constraint declared by the immediate parent

dependency_name.description: Alias name declared by the immediate parent (absent when same as package_name)

extras.description: PyPI extras for this dependency (absent for non-PyPI or when unused)

children.description: Transitive packages directly required by this package

TransitivePackageMetrics.description: Metrics for a transitive package, deduplicated by (package_name, installed_version); path and constraint data lives in dependency_tree

id.description: Zero-based index into the transitive_packages array; matched by DependencyTreeNode.ref

is_optional_dependency.description: Whether this is a development/optional dependency; always false for transitive deps

latest_in_range.description: Newest installable version satisfying version_constraint; equals installed_version when the declared range admits nothing newer. Null only when undeterminable — e.g. the range is satisfiable only below installed_version (manifest/lockfile divergence).

latest_in_major.description: Newest installable version sharing installed_version's major line (PEP 440 epoch + first release segment on PyPI; semver major on npm); equals installed_version when the major line is exhausted. Null only when undeterminable.

latest_compatible_major.description: Newest installable version among majors >= installed_version's major that carries no known module-system/API break; diverges from latest_in_major when a clean major sits between installed_version and a known break. Null only when undeterminable.

module_system.description: installed_version's own module format: 'esm-only', 'cjs' or 'dual' (npm only; always null on PyPI)

recommended_module_system.description: recommended_version's own module format; null whenever recommended_version is null or PyPI

engine_requirement.description: recommended_version's own runtime requirement, e.g. {'node': '>=20.19.0'}; null when recommended_version is null or declares no engine requirement

engine_compatible.description: False when engine_requirement conflicts with the scan's engine_context; null = no evidence either way (no requirement, or no engine_context to compare against)

next_action.description: The single next action for this package, exactly as the CLI's What's Next column and the HTML report show it; absent when nothing is due. The agent payload's next_action applies two further escalations on top of this label and can therefore differ.

rejected_candidates.description: Releases that would have been the recommendation but were held back by a requires-consistency conflict; capped at one per ladder rung

time_lag_days.description: Days between installed and latest version

version_age_days.description: Days since the installed version was published to the registry

releases_lag.description: Number of releases between installed and latest

cve.description: Known CVEs for this package (absent when empty)

constraint_source_file.description: File that introduced a non-DECLARED constraint for this package (absent when DECLARED)

license.description: SPDX license identifiers parsed from the package license expression

purl.description: Package URL (PURL) per ECMA-386, e.g. pkg:pypi/requests@2.25.1 or pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21

is_prerelease.description: Whether the installed version is a pre-release (alpha/beta/rc/dev)

is_yanked.description: Whether the installed version has been yanked or unpublished from the registry

is_deprecated.description: Whether the installed package or version is deprecated (npm-only; false otherwise)

is_package_unpublished.description: Whether the entire package has been removed from the registry (npm-only; false otherwise)

epss.description: Highest EPSS score among this package's CVEs

runs_code_at_install.description: Whether the installed version executes arbitrary code during install

install_execution_reason.description: Human-readable reason for runs_code_at_install; null when unknown or not detected

maintenance_coverage.description: Fraction of the maintenance observations that were available

maintenance_risk.description: P(abandoned) + P(deprecated) from the maintenance-state model; the value that feeds triage

flow_trend.description: Direction of the issue/PR flow ratio over the engagement window

engagement_buckets.description: Raw flow buckets behind flow_trend, oldest ~30-day bucket first: one [issues_opened, issues_closed, prs_opened, prs_merged] row per bucket

deprecation_signals.description: Explicit end-of-life markers found for the package

deprecation_successor.description: Replacement package named in the metadata / deprecation message / README

gap_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-commit gaps from the last 100 commits; volume-free, unlike a weekly-bucket CV. Null below 20 sampled gaps

median_gap_days.description: Median inter-commit gap, in days, from the sampled commits

silence_days.description: Days since the most recent sampled commit

silence_p.description: Empirical probability, from this repository's own gap history, of a silence this long

commits_sampled.description: Non-bot commits that entered the gap measurement

span_days.description: Time span, in days, covered by the sampled commits

days_since_push.description: Days since the last push to the upstream repository

archived.description: Whether the upstream repository is archived

triage_action.description: Recommended action from the EPSS x maintenance matrix

PackageMetrics.description: Metrics for a single package (used for production and development dependencies)

dependency_name.description: Alias name as declared in the project manifest (null or same as package_name when no alias is used)

is_optional_dependency.description: Whether this is a development/optional dependency

time_lag_days.description: Days between installed and latest version

version_age_days.description: Days since the installed version was published to the registry

releases_lag.description: Number of releases between installed and latest

dependency_path.description: Ancestor chain from root to this package (null for direct dependencies)

version_constraint.description: Effective version specifier used internally for solver/ladder computation (e.g. '^1.2.3', '>=1.0,<2.0'). Last-writer-wins across every parent that declares a spec for this package - not guaranteed to equal the manifest's own declaration. Use version_constraint_declared for the manifest's declared value.

version_constraint_declared.description: Version constraint declared by the project manifest itself (e.g. '^1.2.3', '>=1.0,<2.0'). None when this dependency has no direct manifest entry or is unconstrained. This is the value to show as "the declared constraint".

license.description: SPDX license identifiers parsed from the package license expression

purl.description: Package URL (PURL) per ECMA-386, e.g. pkg:pypi/requests@2.25.1 or pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.21

constraint_type.description: How the version constraint was applied: DECLARED (loose/default spec), NARROWED (explicit range with bounds), PINNED (exact version), ADDITIVE (narrows via constraints file), or OVERRIDE (forces a version regardless of other requirements)

constraint_source_file.description: File that introduced a non-DECLARED constraint (e.g. 'package.json' for npm overrides, 'pyproject.toml' for uv, 'requirements.txt' for pip classic)

extras.description: PyPI extras requested for this dependency (e.g. ["security", "tests"] from requests[security,tests]); null for non-PyPI or when no extras are used

recommended_version.description: Solver-recommended version; null when the package is already at the optimal version

latest_in_range.description: Newest installable version satisfying version_constraint; equals installed_version when the declared range admits nothing newer. Null only when undeterminable — e.g. the range is satisfiable only below installed_version (manifest/lockfile divergence).

latest_in_major.description: Newest installable version sharing installed_version's major line (PEP 440 epoch + first release segment on PyPI; semver major on npm); equals installed_version when the major line is exhausted. Null only when undeterminable.

latest_compatible_major.description: Newest installable version among majors >= installed_version's major that carries no known module-system/API break; diverges from latest_in_major when a clean major sits between installed_version and a known break. Null only when undeterminable.

module_system.description: installed_version's own module format: 'esm-only', 'cjs' or 'dual' (npm only; always null on PyPI)

recommended_module_system.description: recommended_version's own module format; null whenever recommended_version is null or PyPI

breaking_change.description: Reason recommended_version is flagged as a known module-system/API break, e.g. 'ESM-only from 5.0.0'; null when no known break applies

engine_requirement.description: recommended_version's own runtime requirement, e.g. {'node': '>=20.19.0'}; null when recommended_version is null or declares no engine requirement

engine_compatible.description: False when engine_requirement conflicts with the scan's engine_context; null = no evidence either way (no requirement, or no engine_context to compare against)

recommended_from_rung.description: Which version-ladder rung recommended_version came from: 'solver' or 'in_range' sit inside version_constraint and are safe to write as-is; 'in_major' or 'latest' require widening version_constraint first. Null only when recommended_version is null.

requires_constraint_widening.description: True when recommended_version is only reachable by widening version_constraint first - i.e. recommended_from_rung is 'in_major' or 'latest'. `ossiq apply` writes nothing for these; `ossiq plan` reports them under constraint widening instead.

next_action.description: The single next action for this package, exactly as the CLI's What's Next column and the HTML report show it; null when nothing is due. The agent payload's next_action applies two further escalations on top of this label and can therefore differ.

is_prerelease.description: Whether the installed version is a pre-release (alpha/beta/rc/dev)

is_yanked.description: Whether the installed version has been yanked or unpublished from the registry

is_deprecated.description: Whether the installed package or version is deprecated (npm-only; false otherwise)

is_package_unpublished.description: Whether the entire package has been removed from the registry (npm-only; false otherwise)

update_transitive_impacts.description: Transitive dependency impacts projected from the recommended update

rejected_candidates.description: Releases that would have been the recommendation but were held back by a transitive-dependency conflict; capped at one per ladder rung (newest rejected at in_range/in_major/latest)

epss.description: Highest EPSS score among this package's CVEs

runs_code_at_install.description: Whether the installed version executes arbitrary code during install

install_execution_reason.description: Human-readable reason for runs_code_at_install; null when unknown or not detected

maintenance_coverage.description: Fraction of the maintenance observations that were available

maintenance_risk.description: P(abandoned) + P(deprecated) from the maintenance-state model; the value that feeds triage

flow_trend.description: Direction of the issue/PR flow ratio over the engagement window

engagement_buckets.description: Raw flow buckets behind flow_trend, oldest ~30-day bucket first: one [issues_opened, issues_closed, prs_opened, prs_merged] row per bucket

deprecation_signals.description: Explicit end-of-life markers found for the package

deprecation_successor.description: Replacement package named in the metadata / deprecation message / README

gap_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-commit gaps from the last 100 commits; volume-free, unlike a weekly-bucket CV. Null below 20 sampled gaps

median_gap_days.description: Median inter-commit gap, in days, from the sampled commits

silence_days.description: Days since the most recent sampled commit

silence_p.description: Empirical probability, from this repository's own gap history, of a silence this long

commits_sampled.description: Non-bot commits that entered the gap measurement

span_days.description: Time span, in days, covered by the sampled commits

days_since_push.description: Days since the last push to the upstream repository

archived.description: Whether the upstream repository is archived

triage_action.description: Recommended action from the EPSS x maintenance matrix

strategy.description: The update-strategy selector's verdict for this package; null when it never ran

StrategySelectionExport.description: The update-strategy selector's verdict for one package

motives.description: Motives admitted at the run's update-strategy tier for this package: exploitable_cve, suppressed_cve, end_of_life, drift. Empty when nothing was admitted

withheld_reason.description: Set only when no motive was admitted at the run's tier — names the lowest tier that would move this package

requires_widening.description: Whether recommended_version sits outside version_constraint under the run's strategy

escalation.description: Set when the strategy reached past its tier's base ceiling, or every reachable version still carries a qualifying CVE

TransitiveImpactExport.description: Transitive impact of a direct dependency update on a single transitive package

package_name.description: Canonical name of the affected transitive package

current_version.description: Currently installed version; null for brand-new transitive deps not in the current tree

projected_version.description: Best version satisfying all merged constraints; null when no version satisfies (hard conflict)

new_constraint.description: Constraint the updated direct dependency imposes on this transitive dependency

driven_by.description: Canonical name of the direct dependency recommendation driving this impact

has_conflict.description: True when projected_version violates an existing parent constraint

RejectedCandidateExport.description: A release that would otherwise have been the recommendation, held back by a conflict

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this release was held back

fix_age_days.description: Days a fix has been available; null when no fix is known
